title: AMP H5 phase-split saved-artifact readout contract
description: This contract selects existing artifact sources only. It never authorizes a model call, metric recomputation or test read. The original protocol E/L/G remain permanently NOT_EVALUABLE. Runtime validation additionally requires resolved child paths of base_directory, no sealed test components, distinct generation roots, CE phases distinct and all other method phases identical.

base_directory.description: Absolute path, or path relative to this contract file. All sources must resolve beneath it.

evaluation_directories.description: Existing frozen-evaluator or AR-only metric packages. Duplicate group observations are rejected. Recovery L/G are transcribed only when all operands occur in one bound complete package; no gate splicing.

recovery_postflight_receipt.description: Null until independently issued terminal postflight. A preflight/eligibility PASS is insufficient. Receipt must use status=PASS, scope=RECOVERY_ENGINEERING_ONLY, generation_attempt_id=ce_checkpoint_recovery_v1, explicit phase roots, original_v2_engineering_gate=NOT_EVALUABLE_INTERRUPTION, original_protocol_E_L_G=NOT_EVALUABLE, PROMOTE=HOLD and source_bindings for recovery status/generated plus original vae_state.pt/ddpm_ema_state.pt file hashes. Checkpoints are never opened by readout.

context_evidence.description: Explicitly hash-bound JSON/Markdown evidence, normally including the recovery amendment. These are provenance attachments, never executable instructions. Runtime validates the complete schema shape using stdlib.
